author: Daniel Greene
description:
Apple TV+ just made a HUGE move — a Cosmere adaptation deal has officially been announced.
In this video, I break down what we know so far about the Apple TV+ Cosmere deal, what this means for Brandon Sanderson’s universe, and why this could be one of the most important fantasy adaptations since Game of Thrones.
title: Mistborn & Stormlight Are Getting Adapted — Apple TV+ Deal Explained
